paper_title: RLHF Workflow From Reward Modeling to Online RLHF
caption: The training record of preference modeling. From the left to right, we present the records of training loss, gradient norm, and the learning rate, respectively.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the gradient norm recorded during preference model training as a function of training progression. The x-axis is labeled “Training Step,” uses a linear scale, and spans from 0 to about 1300, with regularly spaced tick labels at 0, 200, 400, 600, 800, 1000, and 1200. The y-axis is labeled “Gradient Norm,” uses a linear scale, and ranges from 0 up to a little above 800, with major ticks at 0, 200, 400, 600, and 800. A single blue solid line (no visible markers) labeled “Gradient Norm of Preference Model” starts with very large values near the beginning (around the low-to-mid 800s at step 0), drops sharply within the first few steps to near zero, and then remains close to 0 for most of the remaining steps; there is a distinct isolated spike around the mid-training region (near step ~560) reaching roughly on the order of ~70, after which the line returns to near 0 and continues with small near-zero fluctuations through the end of the x-range (around step ~1300).
